curatedMovie.curiosityHook: As the lamps flicker toward permanent blackout, what forgotten truth about Ember's creation remains buried in its secret passages?
curatedMovie.description: In the underground city of Ember, glowing lamps have kept darkness at bay for generations. When the central generator starts to fail, two teenagers race to decipher clues behind the settlement's forgotten origins.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Fast-paced, suspenseful family fantasy pairing mechanical mystery with an urgent race against total darkness.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Gil Kenan delivers an energetic fantasy adventure where antique machinery, ticking-clock tension, and an intricate mystery keep the underground world engagingly suspenseful.
